newsitem.title: UK: British electricity takeovers -- a summary.
newsitem.headline: British electricity takeovers -- a summary.

text.p: U.S. utility CE Energy's victory over Northern Electric in its 782 million pound ($1.31 billion) hostile takeover of the British regional electricity company (Rec) reduces the number of independent privatised Recs to two from an original 12.
A list of UK electricity takeovers to date is given below.

Of the 12 RECs privatised in 1990, only Yorkshire Electricity Group and Southern Electric remain independent.
